notes: Five-marine squad + one military-frame mech for later. Bake: node tools/bake.js (writes Game/assets/sprites/<id>.png/.json).
supersample 2: each unit is rendered at 2x size and box-filtered 2:1 so edges are antialiased; soften 0.6 replaces the hard outline colour with 60% outline + 40% neighbouring body colour.
swayDeg/swayPx: a baked walk sway (rotate about the feet by sin(phase)*3 deg, shift sin(phase)*1 px perpendicular to the facing) so the walk reads from S/N where the legs hide under the body.
No death animation: the factory has none yet.
Round 3: sizes raised so the S idle body (px within 20 px of meta.center) is 38-40 px wide (rifles 0.97/1.0, medic 1.02, fusion 1.0, sniper 1.42).

vfx false: muzzle flashes / sniper beam / flame cone are not baked (MF.Gen.parts.muzzleFlash is a no-op in the bake page); the game's vfx piece draws tracers, streaks and fusion blobs. Attack frames are pose + recoil only.
Engine: draw the selection ring at meta.center (body centre), not at the feet anchor. The bar's ring (measured on ip_01 at 1305,557) is ~27 px outer radius, ~6 px pink band, teal disc when selected.
Sniper needs a 128 cell for its rifle (tightBox 102 px); everything else fits 96 except fusion (128).

Round 4 (critic r3 to-do): pitch 1.2 rad. Team re-darkened to the bar's register: primary #2a1a52, secondary #312460, leather #241b3a, metal #4c5068, tertiary #1c6f66, accent #5ff0ff (visor/edge lights only), glass #8ff8ff, outline #07060f. tools/bake.js applies team.colors (+ provenance.colorOverrides) to every squad unit at bake time; mech_frame has team:false.
team.paints: teal (#14706a) shoulder plates (pad nodes, secondary/leather) like the bar's teal shoulder edges; not identity, not counted in capFrac.

cap: repaints ONLY the 'head' node: rifles #b8245e, sniper #22b9d6, fusion #d9741c, medic white helm #e8e8e4. marks: the medic's red #c81e2a crosses on the helm crown and the backpack top. capFrac (cap+marks share of S idle opaque px) is printed by the bake: 0.07-0.13.

pose: idle/walk hold the weapon aimed along the facing (the weapon's own mid-attack pose, f=hold, no kick); attack columns are a kick sequence inside the aimed window. Printed barrelErr is the grip +z axis vs the row's facing on screen (max 16 deg, sniper).

blueprint.stride 'topdown' (opt-in; round 5: applied by tools/bake.js at load time, js/humans.js untouched): longer hip swing, less knee lift, wider A-frame while walking, so the feet clear the body from S/N. Every blueprint without the flag animates exactly as before (proof: Game/progress/shots/bake-r4-stride-proof-before/after.png, byte-identical, plus an identical rig hash over 300 random human blueprints).

Bake prints per unit: S idle vMedian / vAbove0.8 / satMedian / capFrac, idle aspect per facing, barrelErr per facing, and visible walk-foot travel (legs keyed magenta/green, occlusion included) for the S and N rows.

Round 5 (critic r4 to-do): silhouette = team.carve: two vertical planes swept back 32 deg from a nose at the chest front clip the chest and the shoulder plates into a forward-pointing wedge seen from above (head: 38 deg). Planes are added to the factory prims' own convex polytopes in the bake page; the factory source is untouched.
team.carve[0].edge: a flat #5ff0ff neon strip (2.4 design units wide, about 2 px at 1x) along each carved chest front edge = the leading-edge cyan V; printed as edgeFrac (<= 0.06).

team.gun: the weapon hand's grip subtree is repainted #2a2c3a (dark gun) and the barrel extended 10 design units past the muzzle with two #5ff0ff ticks; the sniper keeps its own long rifle (extend 0, its built-in cyan bands).

pose.lean 0.2 rad: forward lean on top of the factory pose. pose.aim 'auto': the bake searches a torso yaw (-0.6..0.6 rad) that minimises the worst on-screen barrel error over the 8 facings; the result is stored as pose.twist in each sheet's JSON.
Render: supersample 3, soften 0.8, feather 0.35 (the outermost 1x silhouette px keep 65% alpha) so edges sit in the bar's soft register.
Cells: every squad unit is 128 px now (the longer guns clip 96).

gate: tools/bake.js checks S idle bbox width (alpha>200) <= 40, opaque px 800-900, edgeFrac <= 0.06, vMedian <= 0.5, vAbove0.8 <= 0.15, barrel error <= 8 deg, plus per-unit reach (rifles >= 45, fusion >= 42), sniper body-aspect spread <= 0.35 and vAbove0.8 <= 0.08. A unit outside its gate is not written and the bake exits 1 (--nogate for exploration).
Top-down stride: blueprint.stride 'topdown' is spliced into js/humans.js as served to the bake page (tools/bake.js strideHumans()); js/humans.js on disk is back to its committed content.
